rules_help: JSON rules: include/exclude (number lists), even (even count), sum_min/sum_max, neighbors_max, regions ([1–15,16–30,31–45]), overlap_max. weight: frequent/rare/absent is a soft weight; all other rules are hard filters. Analysis → Generate tips.
import_help: CSV, JSON, Joker PDFs and archived or current 6aus45 databases can be imported after preview. Manage draw sources under File → Settings. Table: stored draws per year.
match_tips: Match active series against past draws
history_gap: Lotto history from 1986 and Joker history from 1988 were transferred from archives and existing old databases. Annual coverage and sources are recorded; missing prize amounts remain visible.
